name: Paid / Annual Leave
description: Annual standard earned privilege leave for rest and personal time off.

name: Sick Leave
description: Medical recuperation and health appointment leaves.

name: Casual Leave
description: Short-notice leaves for urgent personal and family matters.

name: Compensatory Off
description: Compensatory rest for approved weekend or holiday overtime shifts.

name: Unpaid Leave
description: Leave without pay (Loss of Pay) when paid quotas are exhausted.
